description: This file is a Perl module implementing integration between Git and Subversion (SVN). It contains functions for managing SVN repositories, mapping revisions, handling properties, and facilitating synchronization, logging, and repository manipulations within a Git context.

classes.name: Git::SVN
classes.description: Main class providing integration functions for managing SVN repositories within Git, including revision mapping, repository management, and synchronization.

methods.name: resolve_local_globs
methods.description: Resolves glob specifications in the context of SVN references, mapping reference names to fetch paths and handling conflicts.

methods.name: parse_revision_argument
methods.description: Parses revision arguments provided via command-line or configuration, returning appropriate revision range endpoints.

methods.name: fetch_all
methods.description: Fetches all revision references from remote SVN repositories as specified in configuration.

methods.name: read_all_remotes
methods.description: Reads SVN remote configurations and properties, storing them in a hash structure.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a new SVN remote repository configuration object with URL and path.

methods.name: find_ref
methods.description: Finds the configuration ref corresponding to a given SVN URL or reference name, returning associated repo ID and path.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new SVN repository object, optionally initializing from a specific reference or URL.

methods.name: svm_uuid
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the SVN Virtual Management (SVM) if available.

methods.name: svm
methods.description: Returns SVM properties if configured, including source URL, UUID, and replacement URL.

methods.name: ra_uuid
methods.description: Returns the UUID associated with the repository's revision author, caching locally.

methods.name: repos_root
methods.description: Returns the repository root URL, caching it in configuration.

methods.name: ra
methods.description: Creates a new SVN::Ra object for repository access, applying SVM-related configurations if applicable.

methods.name: prop_walk
methods.description: Recursively walks through directory properties in SVN to invoke a callback on directories containing specific properties.

methods.name: last_rev
methods.description: Returns the newest SVN revision number fetched for the repository.

methods.name: last_commit
methods.description: Returns the commit SHA1 for the latest revision.

methods.name: last_rev_commit
methods.description: Returns the latest SVN revision and commit SHA1 as a pair.

methods.name: get_fetch_range
methods.description: Calculates the range of revisions to fetch, bounded by the repository's latest revision.

methods.name: svn_dir
methods.description: Returns the Git SVN directory path.

methods.name: verify_remotes_sanity
methods.description: Validates SVN remote configurations for ambiguity or conflicts.

methods.name: find_existing_remote
methods.description: Finds an existing remote repository configuration matching a given URL.

methods.name: init_remote_config
methods.description: Initializes remote configuration with URL, setting up paths and properties.

methods.name: find_by_url
methods.description: Finds an SVN remote configuration matching a URL, optional repository root, and path.

methods.name: call_authors_prog
methods.description: Executes configured author processing program to resolve author name and email.

methods.name: check_author
methods.description: Validates and processes author information, applying program-based resolution if needed.

methods.name: find_extra_svk_parents
methods.description: Finds and appends extra parent commits for SVK merge tickets based on revision and ticket info.

methods.name: lookup_svn_merge
methods.description: Analyzes merge information for an SVN revision, identifying merged commit ranges.

methods.name: _rev_list
methods.description: Generates a list of revisions within a specified range using 'rev-list' command.

methods.name: check_cherry_pick2
methods.description: Checks for commits in a range that are cherry-picked or have no changes.

methods.name: has_no_changes
methods.description: Determines if a given commit has no changes by comparing trees.

methods.name: tie_for_persistent_memoization
methods.description: Sets up persistent in-memory caching for SVN revision data using Memoize backend.

methods.name: unmemoize_svn_mergeinfo_functions
methods.description: Removes memoization wrappers for SVN merge info functions.

methods.name: clear_memoized_mergeinfo_caches
methods.description: Clears persistent caches related to SVN merge info.

methods.name: mergeinfo_changes
methods.description: Computes differences in svn:mergeinfo properties between revisions.

methods.name: parents_exclude
methods.description: Determines which commits should be excluded based on parent commit information.

methods.name: make_log_entry
methods.description: Constructs a structured log entry from SVN revision data, including metadata and related commits.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches revision data within a specified revision range from SVN into Git.

methods.name: set_tree_cb
methods.description: Callback to set a tree structure for a specific revision and update repository state.

methods.name: set_tree
methods.description: Replaces the Git tree for the current revision.

methods.name: rebuild_from_rev_db
methods.description: Rebuilds revision mapping from a stored revision database.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds the revision mapping database from SVN history, optionally including SVM properties.

methods.name: rev_map_set
methods.description: Associates an SVN revision number with a Git commit hash in persistent storage.

methods.name: use_fsync
methods.description: Determines whether filesystem syncs should be used, based on environment variable and configuration.
